scope: The principal Nan Hua Temple shrine at Bronkhorstspruit as documented in March 2006. Includes the main two-tier hall, raised podium and stairs, and short roofed connections within the mapped main-shrine footprint. The enclosing precinct, separate main gate, guesthouse and shrine interior are outside the scope.

originalReview.notes: Front image shows the large two-tier orange tiled roof, upturned corners, colored bracket friezes, dark red columns, raised white balustraded podium and broad divided stairs.

East approach image corroborates the main hall as the largest building at the rear of the precinct, the lateral roofed connections, reddish tile and two stacked silhouettes. The detached entrance and corner halls are excluded.

quallaSearch.notes: Two exact Qualla photos have the original Elf-friend first-person creator credit, March 2006 native upload history and explicit public-domain grants preserved in the Commons transfer. The guesthouse photo depicts a different building and was excluded. No supplemental imagery was used.
